slug: 2025-07-31 Isiolo County Onboarded onto Ardhisasa as More Counties Embrace the Platform

facts.fact: The State Department for Lands says Ardhisasa, built on NLIMS, offers searches, transfers and subdivisions online, with Isiolo County Blocks 1-10 live.
The State Department for Lands says it continues rolling out Ardhisasa across counties, with Marsabit and Baringo next after Isiolo and Mombasa Island.
